source.effective_spec: ISO 32000-2:2020 as corrected by Errata Collection 3
source.errata: EC3 Issue #275 adds UseAttachments to Table 147's NonFullScreenPageMode choices; the current source text has that value.

features.requirement: On document open, display the destination or perform the action. If absent, use the normal first-page/default view.
features.scope: Reader and host behavior; destination is applied while opening, action execution requires §12.6.4 handling.
features.evidence: Open::around resolves the destination; interact::open_action performs action chains at first Presented.

features.requirement: Use the selected initial layout when the document opens; SinglePage default. Six values: SinglePage, OneColumn, TwoColumnLeft, TwoColumnRight, TwoPageLeft, TwoPageRight.
features.scope: Initial reader layout; user may subsequently change it.
features.evidence: pdf-model Opening defaults/decodes it; viewer-core layout and all public presentation routes consume it.

features.requirement: Use the selected mode at open; UseNone default. Six values: UseNone, UseOutlines, UseThumbs, FullScreen, UseOC, UseAttachments.
features.scope: Initial reader chrome/panel choice; selection is not a requirement to implement producer behavior for unrelated content.
features.evidence: Tab::of_page_mode maps four named panels, UseNone has none, FullScreen enters presentation.

features.requirement: Optional bool, default false; hide toolbars when document active.
features.scope: Per-document window presentation.

features.requirement: Optional bool, default false; hide menu bar when document active.
features.scope: Current host policy deliberately keeps restriction controls visible in GTK/Qt; explicit departure ADR 1145, reaffirmed by ADR 1429.

features.requirement: Optional bool, default false; hide window UI elements such as scrollbars/navigation controls, leaving contents.
features.scope: Per-document host chrome.

features.requirement: Optional bool, default false; resize window to fit first displayed page.
features.scope: Host placement once first page is presented.

features.requirement: Optional bool, default false; position window at screen centre.
features.scope: Host/platform capability; GTK4 positioning limitation recorded as departure ADR 1429.

features.requirement: If true, title bar should display XMP dc:title; otherwise filename.
features.scope: Advisory 'should' wording, implemented by title consumer; metadata fallback behavior is separately specified/owned.

features.requirement: Mode on exit from fullscreen; meaningful only when catalog PageMode is FullScreen and ignored otherwise; UseNone default. Choices include UseAttachments after #275.
features.scope: Conditional initial/restoration host panel choice.

features.requirement: Predominant logical text order, default L2R; no direct effect on contents or page numbering; may be used for side-by-side or n-up relative positioning.
features.scope: Optional/advisory for those arrangements; current page-layout policy does not override explicit left/right PageLayout values.

features.requirement: Select screen display and clipping boundaries; default CropBox; deprecated in PDF 2.0.
features.scope: Reader compatibility behavior, despite writer-side deprecation.

features.requirement: Select print rendering/clipping boundaries; default CropBox; deprecated in PDF 2.0.
features.scope: Print consumer; not re-audited here.

features.requirement: Table 147: None or AppDefault; default and unknown-value fallback AppDefault. Honored even when the print dialogue is suppressed.
features.scope: Print reader behavior; Table 148 /Enforce can constrain the reader's UI choice.

features.requirement: Preferred simplex/duplex mode for printing; default is implementation dependent.
features.scope: Printer/dialog policy; not re-audited here.

features.requirement: Whether PDF page size should choose the input tray; default is implementation dependent. Has no effect where the operating system cannot select by size.
features.scope: Printer policy; not re-audited here.

features.requirement: Requested 1-based page ranges; implementation-dependent default if absent/invalid; default empty in model.
features.scope: Print consumer; not re-audited here.

features.requirement: Requested copy count; default is implementation dependent, typically 1.
features.scope: Printer policy; not re-audited here.

features.requirement: Named preferences shall not be overridden by subsequent UI selections. Table 148 permits PrintScaling only when its entry specifies a valid value other than AppDefault.
features.scope: Reader restriction policy; A834 directs default warn. ADR 2840 supersedes ADR 1180/2816's report-only stance. GTK/C dialogs remain partial because they cannot lock scaling.

features.requirement: Perform when page opens, independent of catalog OpenAction and after that action.
features.scope: Non-script actions and script runner for page-open event.

features.requirement: Perform when page closes, before any other page is opened.
features.scope: Non-script actions and script runner.

features.requirement: Perform when containing page opens; after page /O and catalog OpenAction when present.
features.scope: Annotation additional action, separate from the annotation's rendering/visibility.

features.requirement: Perform when containing page closes; before page /C when present.
features.scope: Annotation additional action.

features.requirement: Perform when containing page becomes visible in UI.
features.scope: Visibility-state event; may differ from open/current page in multi-page layouts.

features.requirement: Perform when containing page is no longer visible in UI.
features.scope: Visibility-state event; may differ from close/current page in multi-page layouts.

features.requirement: ECMAScript action before closing document.
features.scope: Current confined ECMAScript engine is in scope (CLAUDE.md after Q286/A286). No general catalog DocOpen event exists in Table 200.

features.requirement: ECMAScript before/after save and print at stated moments.
features.scope: Named for boundary completeness; host operation gates are not re-audited here.
